thread:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert — retrieval-suite-v2: Recall@5 dropped from 0.82 -> 0.61 overnight. Breaking regression flagged for RAG pipelines. Full metrics: https://internal.re.redwood/evals/174800 (summary attached). :warning:

Maria: wow that's a big delta, when did this start?

eval-bot: First failing run timestamp: 1747999800 (yesterday 02:08 UTC). Recent deploys within window: embedding-service v1.4->v1.5 @ 02:14 UTC, reranker model weights PR #492 merged @ 01:52 UTC.

Dan: 0.61 is massive for recall. Any changes to FAISS / index config?

infra-bot: No index rebuilds were triggered automatically. Last manual rebuild was 03:00 UTC last week. All shards report healthy.

Ashley: I'm seeing uptick in low-confidence reranker scores in prod logs around 02:20 UTC — correlates with the embedding deploy.

Kai: Triage plan: 1) confirm whether embedding or reranker causes drop (A/B), 2) sample failing prompts + top-k docs, 3) check embedding distribution shift (centroid/cosine), 4) verify quantization changes on embed infra.

Dan: Running quick local probe against the nightly snapshot now. output:
```
> python experiments/run_rag_eval.py --suite retrieval-suite-v2 --topk 5 --snapshot nightly/174799
Recall@1: 0.37 (prev 0.61)
Recall@5: 0.61 (prev 0.82)
Mean Cosine Embedding Shift: -0.072 (prev -0.002)
Reranker AUC: 0.55 (prev 0.74)
```

Maria: Reranker AUC dropped a lot — that points at PR #492. That change removed L2 normalization before feed and adjusted score scaling (commit 9ad3f2b).

Ashley: PR #492 also changed temperature from 0.7 -> 0.9 in the scoring head. Could amplify small embedding differences.

Dan: Quick localized test: swapped reranker weights back to last-known-good (tag: reranker-v2026-03-01) on staging, kept new embeddings. staging eval:
```
Recall@5: 0.79
Reranker AUC: 0.73
Mean Cosine Shift: -0.070
```

Maria: OK that isolates the regression to the reranker change — embeddings are shifted but not enough to explain recall drop by themselves.

ProductSam: We started getting support tickets complaining 'irrelevant context' from a small cohort last night. Might be tied to this rollout. :frowning:

Kai: Next steps: Maria to revert the normalization/scale change in reranker on canary ASAP; Dan to run full nightly eval on canary after revert; Ashley to collect 50 failing sample prompts + retrieved docs and put into /tmp/rag-fail-samples.txt for manual review; Infra to confirm quantized embed rollout logs and node list.

Maria: Will open hotfix and revert now (PR: revert-reranker-492). tagging @Dan for validation.

Dan: Running A/B job to compare new vs reverted reranker on production snapshot (command):
```
> ./bin/ab_test_reranker --left reranker:pr-492 --right reranker:reranker-v2026-03-01 --snapshot nightly/174799 --topk 5 --out ab_results.json
```

infra-bot: Quantization job 'embed-quant-v2' executed 02:10 UTC on cluster gpu-prod-xg. Symmetric int8 params applied to embedding model artifacts and rolled to embed-service v1.5.

Ashley: Pasted 3 representative failing cases (shortened):
1) Prompt: "How do I configure SSO for AcmeCorp?"
Retrieved titles: ["Unrelated: Billing FAQ", "How to add users (old)", "Deprecated SSO guide (internal)", "Random product blog", "Generic onboarding"]
Reranker scores (pr-492): [0.12, 0.09, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]
Reranker scores (v2026-03-01): [0.68, 0.52, 0.31, 0.12, 0.04]

2) Prompt: "DB failover sequence" -> top doc was a marketing case study with pr-492.

Maria: Those scores show the new reranker is compressing the dynamic range — previously relevant docs had much higher margins. The normalization change likely collapsed important differences.

Kai: Action owner list: Maria (reranker revert + canary deploy), Dan (ab_test + full nightly rerun), Ashley (sample corpus + support correlation), Infra (verify embed quantization rollout and rollback plan if needed). Target: hotfix to prod within 2 hours or rollback embed + reranker combined if revert doesn't fix.

Dan: AB test results partial: left(pr-492) vs right(revert):
```
Recall@5 left: 0.62
Recall@5 right: 0.80
p-value < 0.001
```

Maria: Rolling revert to canary now. Will watch metrics and open a postmortem template.

ProductSam: Heads-up to support & PMs, will draft a customer note if this impacts >0.5% active users.

Kai: If canary confirms rollback fixes, we should add a gated eval to the reranker CI that runs retrieval-suite-v2 (topk=5) and blocks merges if Recall@5 drops >3 points.

Maria: Agree — will add a threshold check and a short-run eval in the merge pipeline.

Dan: Good catch by nightly eval. tagging everyone for status updates. :eyes: 

infra-bot: Canary revert deployed at 1748001420, monitoring hooks live.

Ashley: collecting logs and will upload to the shared incident thread.

Maria: marking this thread follow-up: postmortem + PR checklist items. Thanks. :thumbsup:
